## 4. Asset Integrity & Safety Rules
- **Zero In-Place Mutations**: No source files inside `Hotel Sunny Point Data/` shall be altered, renamed, deleted, or compressed in place.
- **Optimized Distribution**: Web-optimized copies (WebP / compressed JPG) are stored in the application's `/public/assets/` directory with semantic slug filenames (e.g., `masala-dosa.jpg`, `pesarattu.jpg`, `hotel-facade.jpg`).
